headline: Round 4 judged: photo still wins, but the lights critic is at 70% and the whole-frame critic at 85% (from 99%). A fourth piece added: camera optics.

pieces.name: Eave lights & night exposure
pieces.now: Halos 3–5x the bulb with gaussian tails that stack into apex hot-spots, tighter wash decay, sky grain and a faint roofline bleed, the garage-eave sunburst hunted down, neutral drive spot with shadow casting.

history.gap: Siding overexposed ~2 stops: gables floodlit like a white card, the real lights barely lift the walls above mid-grey. Lesser: dots identical and bloomless, sky too clean, drive lit too evenly.
Falloff: the gable is a uniform fill and the dots are pinheads riding on it; the photo is a tight bright band under the fascia decaying to grey, bulbs brightest of all.

Wash still a flat sheet: the real gable is bright in a ~1 ft band under the bulbs then drops to dim warm grey with clapboard shadows. Lesser: dots too large, neutral white, garage run reads as a strip; window glass glows cyan.
Bulb bloom: bare pin-points are the instant tell. Lesser: wash still too linear and wide, sky noiseless with a knife-edge roofline, a sourceless sunburst on the garage eave.

pieces.name: Car
pieces.now: Real shadow casting from the drive spot onto the slab under the car, retro-reflective white plate, bulb string reflected in the rear glass, flat tyre sidewalls, softer paint streak.

history.gap: Car ~4 ft too far left and ~5 ft too close relative to the house. Root cause was the camera pose (house rendered ~10% large, shifted right), now fixed. Lesser: plate self-luminous yellow, no specular streaks from the eave lights, no contact shadow.
The body reflects nothing: a cut-out silhouette under a string of bulbs. Lesser: plate still the brightest thing on the car, floats on black, no lens glints.
Ground contact: the tyres hang above the slab over a faint reflection. Lesser: white speckle on the paint instead of a blurred streak, bright exhaust tips and plate, grey tread.
Still floats: the lit slab under and behind the car is as bright as the open drive. Lesser: plate should be a blown white retro-reflective slab, rear glass shows no lights, ribbed sidewalls.

pieces.name: Driveway, walk & beds
pieces.now: Rock strip re-cut as an unmistakable 3 ft diagonal band with defined edges, litter thinned to drifts, dry grass tufts in the bed, dark shrub masses hiding the horizon, joints and tyre lanes and blotch on the drive.

history.gap: Rock strip is basketball-sized faceted boulders on a 30 ft diagonal; the real one is a flat 2 ft band of river rock at grade with two flagstone steppers. Lesser: no warm pools on the ground, lawn is #000, shrubs are identical spheres.
Driveway went black while the lawn became a lit green slab, inverted from reality. Two builders were fighting over the ground; ground brightness now belongs to the lighting builder alone.
The rock strip and steppers exist but are invisible at night; the walk is a narrow ribbon; plants float on bare lawn with no mulch.
The rock strip reads as a pebble disc at the foot of the steps, not a diagonal band with steppers. Lesser: litter reads as a brown plane with a hard edge, mums still orbs, drive sepia and jointless.

pieces.name: Camera optics
pieces.now: New builder adding a night-only post-process pass in scene.js: bloom on emitters, veiling haze, film grain with chroma noise, vignette, lifted noisy blacks. Day frame must be untouched.

pieces.name: Whole frame
pieces.now: Ranked: gables, roofline lights, sky, porch, garage, walk and beds, car, driveway, lawn and edges.

history.gap: The lawn: a flat evenly lit green plane ending in a ruler line. Lesser: bulbs too uniform, no trees against the sky, siding lit flat, driveway a texture not a surface.

Roofline bulbs do not light the house they sit on: the fascia and soffit under each bulb should be warm and 30–40% brighter with a soft bloom. Lesser: 6500K white vs 3000K, no ground contact under the car, no ambient at the frame edges, flat siding.
No camera optics: bloom and glare around emitters, veiling haze, film grain, smeared shadows. Lesser: hard horizon, uniform drive speckle, razor car edges, flat silhouette tree.

log.what: Photo converted (HEIC → demo/exterior_night.jpg).
shot.py fixed: stage view-offset was magnifying exterior shots 2x, orbit clamp pushed low cameras up. Added --night.
Pose night_front registered (pos 26,4,84 · target 12,14,30 · fov 92). Round 0 baseline shot.
Builders launched: lights, car, yard.
Car builder reported: GLB nose was +Z, half-turned; parked at x 26 z 60; silhouette within ~5 px of the photo.
Car critic: photo. Overlay showed the pose itself was off; night_front revised to pos 27,4,90 · target 14,14,30. All builders notified.
Car round 3: body span 334..484 px vs photo 332..485; roofline exact. Critic held until the lights land.
Yard builder round 3 and lights builder round 5 reported. Shot tool orbit limits frozen (late refit was re-clamping distance).
Blind critics on yard and lights: photo both times. Gable-swap claim from the lights builder checked against a photo zoom and rejected: shell matches (left gable low and forward).
Round-2 instructions sent to lights and yard builders.
Round-2 frame shot; four blind critics run (lights, yard, car, whole frame). Photo wins all.
Round-3 instructions sent. Session hit the usage limit; two builders killed mid-round.
Limit reset. All three builders resumed; files verified to parse.
All three round-3 builds reported; a dropped import from concurrent edits was fixed by the car builder.
Round-3 frame shot; lights, yard, car and whole-frame critics launched.
Round-3 critics back: lights 85%, yard 97%, car 97%, whole frame 99% for the photo.
Round-4 instructions sent to all three builders.
All three round-4 builds reported.
Round-4 frame shot; four critics launched.
Round-4 critics back: lights 70%, car 90%, yard 97%, whole frame 85%.
Round-5 instructions sent; optics builder launched.
